references.text: Nadab and Abihu each took their fire pans, brought unauthorized fire before the Lord, illustrating the consequences of offering incense without authorization.
Aaron uses the censer with incense on the Day of Atonement, demonstrating the proper use of the incense offering.
Earlier in the same chapter, Moses gives instructions regarding the censers of Korah and his followers.
The outcome of this test: fire came out from the Lord and consumed the 250 men who were offering incense.
Aaron uses his censer with incense to stop the plague, demonstrating legitimate priestly service.
Instructions concerning the holy incense that was to be used only before the Lord in the sanctuary.
